params.prompt: Create EXACTLY FIFTEEN separate teal-and-cream city bus sprites in FIVE columns and THREE rows, matching every pose and registration in image 1 exactly. This sheet contains ONLY REAR VIEWS. Every single bus FACES AWAY from the viewer; the BACK END, rear window and RED TAILLIGHTS are visible. Never put a front windshield, destination sign or white headlight on the visible back end. Columns are rear three-quarter left 120 degrees, rear three-quarter left 150 degrees, dead straight REAR 180 degrees, rear three-quarter right 210 degrees, rear three-quarter right 240 degrees. Rows are elevation 20,40,60 degrees. Image 2 is the existing painted bus body design; keep its teal paint, cream band, long body, window rhythm, wheels and proportions. Image 3 is the original painted sedan STYLE reference: use the same matte hand-painted gouache grain, subdued night palette and subtle shading. No road, ground, shadows, labels, borders, text or baked glare; all lamps off, red glass only on rear lamps. True transparent alpha 2K square PNG. The pose reference takes priority over trying to show the front of the bus.
